This agreement states the City of Oklahoma City will waive their 10% of the funds for administrating the grant. Oklahoma City will receive $278,025.00, Del City will receive $7,968.00, Midwest City will receive $13,733.00, Edmond will receive $9,782.00 and the County of Oklahoma County $173,157.00. The Sheriff’s Office will utilize the funds in the same manner as the previous JAG funds to support Land Mobile Radio and Equipment/Services contracted through the City of Oklahoma City. The funds are required to be spent by September 30th, 2027. There are no matching funds required. This item is requested by Sheriff Tommie Johnson III.
